text: The Lord reigns, let the nations tremble; he sits enthroned between the cherubim, let the earth shake.
he is exalted over all the nations.
you have established equity; in Jacob you have done what is just and right.
and worship at his footstool; he is holy.
Samuel was among those who called on his name; they called on the Lord and he answered them.
they kept his statutes and the decrees he gave them.
you answered them; you were to Israel a forgiving God, though you punished their misdeeds.
and worship at his holy mountain, for the Lord our God is holy.
